title: Kickoff Questionnaire
purpose: Capture the decisions needed before the first build phase.

questions.label: Primary Goal
questions.prompt: In one sentence, what must this project do to be worth building?

questions.label: Stack
questions.prompt: Which stack should the build target?

questions.label: Must-haves
questions.prompt: Which capabilities are required for v1?

questions.label: Confidence
questions.prompt: How confident are you the spec is buildable as written? (0-10)
